rule: NO_PROGRESS only if over the configured interval ALL hold: package count unchanged AND log unchanged AND (no worker alive OR no worker CPU delta) AND no meaningful UE CPU/I-O delta AND outstanding jobs remain. Package-count stasis alone never triggers (large single packages legitimately stall the counter).
on_trigger: Record WORKER_TERMINATED_UNEXPECTEDLY with evidence bundle; EITHER restart workers and requeue (only if UE4.26 relaunch path proven safe in the bounded test) OR fail the cook explicitly as FAILED_EXPLICITLY preserving -iterate output. Indefinite wait is forbidden.
applies_to: NEW governed operations only; never retro-attached to the running executor import.
